title.en: Films (Class Licence for General Films Distribution) Order 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Films (Class Licence for General Films Distribution) Order 2021 and comes into operation on 1 July 2021.

heading.en: Class licence for distributing appropriate films and exempt unclassified films

text.en:
3. Unless exempt by or under section 40(1) of the Act, every person —
(a)who distributes in the course of business at any of the person’s distribution outlets —
(i)only appropriate films and no other films and no video games; or
(ii)only appropriate films and exempt unclassified films, and no other films and no video games; and
(b)who is not a person to whom a class licence in the Films (Class Licence for Lending by Libraries and Educational Institutions) Order 2019 (G.N. No. S 336/2019) applies or a person to whom the application of that class licence is suspended or disapplied under the Act,
is subject to a class licence in connection with the distribution of appropriate films and exempt unclassified films by that person in the course of business.

4. The condition of this class licence is that every class licensee must not distribute or allow to be distributed at any of the class licensee’s distribution outlets —
(a)a video game; or
(b)a film that is neither an appropriate film nor an exempt unclassified film.
